description: Source code for a sensor fusion implementation in Android, including classes and functions for handling sensor data, state estimation, and sensor parameter tuning.

classes.name: Fusion
classes.description: Class implementing sensor fusion algorithms for orientation and bias estimation.

classes.name: Covariance
classes.description: Template class for calculating covariance matrices from sensor data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Fusion object with a specified mode.

methods.name: initFusion
methods.description: Initializes the fusion state with a quaternion and time delta.

methods.name: hasEstimate
methods.description: Checks if the fusion has a valid estimate.

methods.name: checkInitComplete
methods.description: Checks if initial sensor data collection is complete.

methods.name: checkState
methods.description: Checks and resets the state if divergence is detected.

methods.name: getAttitude
methods.description: Returns the current estimated orientation quaternion.

methods.name: getBias
methods.description: Returns the current estimated sensor bias.

methods.name: getRotationMatrix
methods.description: Returns the current rotation matrix derived from the quaternion.

methods.name: getF
methods.description: Computes the state transition matrix for the quaternion.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts the next state based on angular velocity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the state with a new measurement.

methods.name: getOrthogonal
methods.description: Computes an orthogonal vector to the input vector.
